mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has declined for four consecutive weeks, and this downward momentum persists because the same activity suppression continues; therefore the next 28-day mean will be lower than the last 28-day mean.
failure_condition: If the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is greater than or equal to the last 28-day mean of -21.575, the momentum hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS falls by more than 20 points from its two-week prior level to the current week, it signals a broad mobility restriction that suppresses discretionary retail; RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next 14 days than over the prior 14 days.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls more than 20 points from t-2w to t-0w
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell from -0.4 at t-2w to -24.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is not lower than over the prior 14 days when PARKS drops more than 20 points in two weeks, the threshold hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: The joint pattern of RESIDENTIAL above 3 and TRANSIT below -15 indicates a home-confinement regime that reduces out-of-home retail trips; RETAIL_REC will therefore be lower over the next 28 days than over the last 28 days.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days when RESIDENTIAL>3 and TRANSIT<-15, the interaction hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: The sharp PARKS decline to below -20 reflects a seasonal winter trough rather than retail-specific suppression; as seasonal outdoor activity bottoms, retail-recreation mean over the next 28 days will be higher than the last 28-day mean.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days when PARKS < -20, the seasonal rebound hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GROCERY_PHARM toward zero combined with TRANSIT below -15 signals reduced overall trip-making; because retail-recreation depends on the same trip chain, RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next 28 days than over the last 28 days.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM fell from 7.7 to 1.9 over four weeks
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days when GROCERY_PHARM<3 and TRANSIT<-15, the trip-chain hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has stabilized in the last two weeks at about -13 after an earlier drop, indicating the remote-work shock is no longer accelerating; this stabilization will lift the next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean above the last 28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES was -13.4 at t-3w, -17.0 at t-2w, -12.9 at t-1w, -12.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: If the next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean is not above the last 28-day mean despite WORKPLACES stabilizing near -13, the stabilization hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When RETAIL_REC itself falls below -25, the current level already embeds the full tightening shock; a short-term mean reversion will raise RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days relative to the prior 7 days.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is not higher than over the prior 7 days when RETAIL_REC is below -25, the mean-reversion hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Under a tightening restrictions regime, the simultaneous decline of TRANSIT below -15 and PARKS below -20 indicates broad suppression of non-essential mobility; RETAIL_REC will remain lower over the next 28 days than over the last 28 days.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days when TRANSIT<-15 and PARKS<-20, the regime-conditional suppression hypothesis is rejected.
